method.order: Sequential adjacent before/current pairs; pair order alternates each case.
method.timed_interval: paint_instrument + SDL_RenderFlush + SDL_RenderPresent on an RGBA32 software surface
method.excluded: SDL/Drawing initialization, model construction, warmup, surface hashing, JSON stdout, file IO and teardown
method.paint_split_note: SDL may flush internally during paint; explicit flush/surface-present is the final segment only.
method.p95_definition: Nearest rank: sorted sample 285 of 300; median averages sorted samples 150 and 151.
method.threshold: Investigate only p95 increase >15 percent AND >2 ms versus the paired before renderer.
method.state_fixture: Default copied ControlSnapshot; publication revision 2; held Upper indexes 24,25, Lower 36,37, Pedals 0,1; focused Upper 24; Play; no Session/Engine or audio/MIDI device.
method.quiet_interval: Root and A26/A27 were notified and released heavy builds/tests before this run; virtual host scheduling remains outside task control.

investigation.conclusion: The initial reference Flat/no-overlay p95 trigger did not reproduce in the sole approved reverse-order repeat. Both observations are retained separately without averaging. The original tail was in paint, while the explicit flush/surface-present segment remained below0.002 ms. These data establish interval variability, not its cause or statistical equivalence. No persistent regression or actionable paint hotspot is demonstrated; no optimization or additional run was performed.

qualification: Completed nine same-geometry paired cells and the one threshold-triggered investigation. All three Dimensional material cells and three Flat overlays were below the combined investigation threshold. One original reference Flat/no-overlay control trigger remains recorded and did not reproduce in one reverse-order repeat. This is source-specific software-surface paint+flush+present timing, not display FPS, audio latency, a real-device deadline or a cross-device claim.
